text: Fernbridge Logistics runs about 200 delivery vehicles across six Southeast states, scanning roughly 82,000 packages a day. Every scanner and GPS tracker already streams constantly -- nobody has ever built anywhere for that data to go.

Operations VP Renata Ocampo pulls a 90-minute manual CSV export every morning, so trend reports are already a day stale. Support Director Devon Marsh fields 310 calls a day with no way to see today's status at all.
Those sound like one complaint. They're actually two different problems: a slow historical report, and a real-time status view that has simply never existed.
Naming them separately in this first meeting, out loud, with both leaders agreeing, is what keeps the next nineteen videos from building the wrong thing.
Next: turning Devon's 'we need real-time visibility' into an exact, testable requirement.
